settings.title: Organization Settings
settings.noAccess: You don't have access to this page
settings.name: Organization Name
settings.localeHint: Used for receipts, emails, and number formatting
settings.logoHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, or SVG. Max {size}MB.
settings.invoiceAnnualResetDesc: Reset receipt numbering at the start of each year
settings.sepaFormatDesc: ISO 20022 pain.008 — standard for all SEPA-zone banks
settings.genderOptionsDesc: Configure the gender options available in member forms. Each option needs a value key and labels in all languages.

providers.title: Payment Providers
providers.description: Configure payment provider credentials and settings
providers.webhookHint: Register this address as the webhook endpoint in the provider's dashboard. Subscribe to {events}, with the Snapshot payload style; memship ignores every other event.

fieldHints.enable_bizum: Turn this on only once your bank has confirmed Bizum is enabled on this terminal. Memship cannot check it.

stripe.secret_key: In Stripe, Developers → API keys. Starts with sk_test_ in test mode and sk_live_ in live mode.
stripe.webhook_secret: Issued by Stripe, not by memship: first create the webhook endpoint shown below in Stripe, then reveal its signing secret. Starts with whsec_.

redsys.merchant_code: Your merchant identifier, 7 to 9 digits, from the TPV Virtual contract or your bank's portal.
redsys.terminal_id: Numeric, usually 1 unless your bank issued several terminals.
redsys.secret_key: Bank portals usually call it clave secreta de encriptación or clave de firma. Test and production have different keys.
redsys.currency_code: ISO 4217 numeric code: 978 is the euro.

errors.cannot_clear_stored_secret: {field} cannot be emptied — paste the new value over it, or delete the provider
errors.prefix_only: {field} is only the prefix — paste the whole key

webhookEvents.title: Payment notifications
webhookEvents.description: Gateway notifications that could not be applied or were ignored. An ignored notification for an already-paid receipt may be a double charge.
webhookEvents.rejected: {provider}: {count, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}} refused at the signature check in the last {days} days. Last: {at} — {reason}
webhookEvents.rejectedHint: If these keep arriving, the configured webhook secret is wrong and no payment is being confirmed.
webhookEvents.rejectedUnavailable: The count of refused notifications could not be read.

recurringBilling.title: Recurring billing
recurringBilling.enabledDesc: Automatically generate membership-fee receipts on the configured schedule
recurringBilling.dayDesc: Day (1–31) the billing runs; a shorter month is billed on its last day. Quarterly and annual fees are only billed in the first month of their period.
recurringBilling.notificationEmailDesc: Optional address that receives the summary of each automatic run and urgent alerts about payments received for cancelled seats. If empty, no summary is sent and urgent alerts go to the club's email.

paymentReminders.title: Payment reminders
paymentReminders.enabledDesc: Automatically email members about overdue receipts on the configured schedule
paymentReminders.daysAfterDueDesc: Days after the due date before the first reminder is sent
paymentReminders.maxCountDesc: Maximum number of reminders per receipt (1–10)

donations.title: Member donations
donations.enabledDesc: Adds a Donate button to the member portal. It charges through the gateway you already use for fees; there is nothing else to configure
donations.minAmountDesc: The smallest amount accepted, and what the suggested amounts come from (the minimum and its multiples by 2, 5 and 10)
donations.maxAmountDesc: The largest amount accepted, so a typo cannot become an enormous charge
donations.messageDesc: What the member reads before choosing an amount, in your own words. Left empty, the page just shows the amounts

membershipLapse.title: Non-payment
membershipLapse.enabled: Revert unpaid members to the free tier
membershipLapse.enabledDesc: A member whose membership fee stays unpaid past the grace period goes back to the free default plan. Their receipt stays owed, and activities they already signed up for are kept.
membershipLapse.dueDaysDesc: Days from issue until a membership fee is due. Kept short on purpose: the fee pays for the plan the member is using meanwhile.
membershipLapse.graceDaysDesc: Days after the due date — or after a returned direct debit — before the plan is withdrawn.
membershipLapse.summary: A member loses their plan about {days} days after the fee is issued. Paying it restores the plan, however they pay.
membershipLapse.noRemindersWarning: Payment reminders are switched off, so nobody is chased before losing access: the member's first notice is the plan disappearing. Enable payment reminders to warn them first.

communications.title: Announcements module
communications.enabledDesc: On: staff get the Communications screen to write and broadcast announcements, and members get the notification bell and their Announcements page. Off: all three disappear and the announcement emails stop. Existing announcements are kept and come back if you switch it on again.
communications.description: Master switch for the announcements feature. It does not affect the member emails below, which keep sending either way.

memberCard.title: Digital Member Card
memberCard.enabledDesc: Give members a digital card with a QR code for check-in.
memberCard.assignNumbers: Assign numbers to members without one

sso.title: Single sign-on (SSO)
sso.description: Let members sign in with Google or Apple. Enter each provider's credentials and switch it on — no redeploy needed.
sso.enableHint: Enable once the credentials are saved.
sso.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value; enter a new one to replace it.
sso.consoleHint: Paste the backend URL and each redirect URI into the Google / Apple developer console.
sso.encryptionKeyMissing: The server has no usable encryption key: either its key file could not be created (check that the storage volume is writable) or MEMSHIP_SECRET_KEY is not a valid key. Secret fields cannot be saved until this is fixed.
sso.encryptionKeyRequired: Could not save the secret: the server has no working encryption key.
sso.encryptionActive: Encryption active: secrets are stored encrypted with a server-managed key and are never shown here.

mailing.title: Mail provider
mailing.description: Choose and configure the provider your emails are sent through. Only one can be active at a time.

hints.resend: Managed delivery through the Resend API.
hints.smtp: Any SMTP server: your organisation's mail hosting, a sending service, or a Gmail account.
hints.sendpulse: Managed delivery through the SendPulse API. Configured here only, not through environment variables.

mailing.oneAtATime: Only one provider can be active at a time.
mailing.gmailPresetHint: Fills in smtp.gmail.com, port 587 and STARTTLS. Gmail needs an app password, not the account password.
mailing.securityHint: STARTTLS is the usual choice, on port 587. Pick direct SSL/TLS only if your server encrypts from the first byte, usually on port 465. No encryption is for a local-network server only.
mailing.invalidPort: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
mailing.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value; enter a new one to replace it.
mailing.fillCredsFirst: Fill in the credentials before activating it.
mailing.activationNeedsSave: Save and test the new credentials before activating it.
mailing.activationNeedsTest: Send a successful test before activating it.
mailing.testNeedsReady: Configure and save the credentials first.
mailing.testNeedsSave: Save your changes before sending the test.
mailing.providerNotReady: Credentials for that provider are missing.
mailing.providerNotVerified: That provider has not passed a test with its current credentials. Save them, send a test, then activate it.
mailing.encryptionActive: Encryption active: secrets are stored encrypted with a server-managed key and are never shown here.
mailing.encryptionKeyMissing: The server has no usable encryption key: either its key file could not be created (check that the storage volume is writable) or MEMSHIP_SECRET_KEY is not a valid key. Secret fields cannot be saved until this is fixed.
mailing.encryptionKeyRequired: Could not save the secret: the server has no working encryption key.

health.unverified: Not verified: nothing has been sent with these credentials yet. Send a test to check them.
health.ok: Working: the last email through these credentials was accepted on {date}.
health.failing: Failing: the last email through these credentials was refused on {date}. {reason}

failures.rejected_recipient: The provider refused the recipient address.
failures.rate_limited: The provider's sending limit was reached.
failures.transport_unavailable: The provider could not be reached.
failures.unknown: The provider gave no recognisable reason; send a test to see its message.

emailTemplates.title: Member emails
emailTemplates.description: Which emails the system sends out. These control email only — in-app notifications and the portal are unaffected, and a member who has opted out of email never receives any of them. Account-access emails cannot be switched off.

groupDescriptions.auth: Sent when someone activates an account or recovers a password. Always on — there is no other way in.
groupDescriptions.members: Sent when an admin approves or rejects a sign-up request.
groupDescriptions.activities: Sent when a member's place in an activity changes — confirmed, waitlisted, cancelled, or promoted off the waitlist.
groupDescriptions.bookings: Sent when a member's booking of a space changes — confirmed, waitlisted, cancelled by the club, or promoted off the waitlist.
groupDescriptions.billing: Sent when a receipt is issued or falls overdue, plus the internal summary of each billing run.
groupDescriptions.broadcasts: Email delivery of announcements. Switch it off and announcements still appear in the app — they just stop going out by email.

featureOff.communications: The announcements module is switched off above, so nothing is sent either way.

verification.name: Email verification
verification.locked: Without this email a new account cannot be activated.

password_reset.name: Password reset
password_reset.locked: The only way to recover access to an account.

registration_existing_account.name: Signup on an existing address
registration_existing_account.locked: The only warning an owner gets that someone tried to sign up as them.

registration_approved.name: Registration approved
registration_approved.description: Tells the member their registration was approved and they can log in.
registration_approved.warning: The member has no other signal that their registration was approved.

registration_rejected.name: Registration rejected
registration_rejected.description: Tells the applicant their registration was not accepted.

registration_confirmed.name: Registration confirmed
registration_confirmed.description: Confirms a registration for an activity.

registration_waitlisted.name: Registration waitlisted
registration_waitlisted.description: Says the registration went onto the waitlist.

registration_pending_payment.name: Registration pending payment
registration_pending_payment.description: Tells the member their seat is held until they pay, when they register or when a seat comes to them from the waiting list, with the amount, the deadline and how to pay.
registration_pending_payment.warning: It is the only notice that they have to pay. Without it, the member will not know their seat depends on payment.

payment_deadline_reminder.name: Seat about to expire
payment_deadline_reminder.description: Reminds the member, before the deadline, that their seat will be cancelled unless paid.
payment_deadline_reminder.warning: Without this notice, the automatic cancellation will come as a surprise to the member.

late_payment_alert.name: Payment received for a cancelled seat
late_payment_alert.description: Alerts the club, urgently, when the gateway collects for a seat that had already been released.
late_payment_alert.warning: Without this alert, the club will not know it holds money it may have to return.

registration_cancelled_unpaid.name: Registration cancelled for non-payment
registration_cancelled_unpaid.description: Tells the member their seat was released because it was not paid in time.
registration_cancelled_unpaid.warning: Without this notice, the member will not know they lost the seat.

late_payment_refund.name: Late payment without a seat
late_payment_refund.description: Tells the member when their payment arrives after the seat was released and none is free: they are not registered and will be refunded.
late_payment_refund.warning: Without it, the member will not know they lost the seat or that the money will be returned.

waitlist_promoted.name: Activity place freed up
waitlist_promoted.description: Tells the member they moved off the activity waitlist and their registration is confirmed.
waitlist_promoted.warning: The member gained a place and must act on it. Without the email they will not turn up.

booking_confirmation.name: Booking confirmed
booking_confirmation.description: Confirms a booking of a space.

booking_waitlisted.name: Booking waitlisted
booking_waitlisted.description: Says the booking went onto the waitlist.

booking_promoted.name: Booking place freed up
booking_promoted.description: Tells the member their booking is now confirmed.
booking_promoted.warning: The member gained a place and must act on it. Without the email they will not turn up.

booking_cancelled.name: Booking cancelled by the club
booking_cancelled.description: Tells the member the club cancelled their booking.
booking_cancelled.warning: The member will turn up for a booking that no longer exists.

booking_pending_payment.name: Booking awaiting payment
booking_pending_payment.description: Tells the member their booking is held until they pay, when they book or when a place comes to them from the waiting list, with the amount, the time limit and how to pay.
booking_pending_payment.warning: It is the only notice that they have to pay. Without it, the member will not know their booking depends on payment.

booking_deadline_reminder.name: Booking deadline reminder
booking_deadline_reminder.description: Warns the member, shortly before the time limit, that their booking will be cancelled unless paid.
booking_deadline_reminder.warning: Without it, the member loses the booking without knowing it was about to expire.

booking_cancelled_unpaid.name: Booking cancelled for non-payment
booking_cancelled_unpaid.description: Tells the member their booking was cancelled because it was not paid in time.
booking_cancelled_unpaid.warning: Without it, the member will turn up for a booking they no longer hold.

booking_seat_available.name: Place freed at the last minute
booking_seat_available.description: Tells those on the waiting list that a place freed too close to the start to be handed out by itself: whoever books and pays first takes it.
booking_seat_available.warning: Without it, a place freed at the last minute stays empty: nobody on the waiting list will know they can book it.

receipt_delivery.name: Receipt delivery
receipt_delivery.description: Sends the receipt PDF to the member when it is issued.
receipt_delivery.warning: Members stop receiving their receipts by email.

payment_reminder.name: Payment reminder
payment_reminder.description: Chases overdue receipts on the configured schedule.
payment_reminder.warning: Overdue receipts stop being chased by email.

payment_confirmation.name: Payment confirmation
payment_confirmation.description: Tells the member their payment has been recorded.
payment_confirmation.warning: Members paying by direct debit, cash or transfer get no signal that their payment arrived.

billing_summary.name: Billing summary
billing_summary.description: Internal summary of each billing run, to the admin address.

announcement.name: Announcements
announcement.description: Delivery of the announcements admins broadcast.

webhook_digest.name: Payment notification problems
webhook_digest.description: Daily summary, to the billing notification address, of failed, ignored or refused payment notifications.

registration.title: Public registration
registration.flowClosed: Sign-up is closed. Members exist only when an administrator creates them.
registration.flowApproval: Anyone can sign up, and every sign-up waits in the pending queue for an administrator. Nothing is billed before that decision.
registration.flowImmediate: Anyone can sign up and becomes a member straight away, on the free tier below. Only an administrator ever moves someone to a paid tier.
registration.publicEnabledDesc: Show the sign-up form and accept registrations from anyone who reaches it
registration.requiresApprovalDesc: New sign-ups wait as pending until an administrator approves them; the member number is issued then, so an abandoned sign-up burns none
registration.defaultTierDesc: Only a free membership type can be the default, so signing up never starts a fee on its own
registration.noFreeTiers: There is no free membership type yet. Create one under Membership Types and it can become the default.

activityPayments.title: Paid activities
activityPayments.autoCancelDesc: If the member does not pay in time, the registration is cancelled and the seat is released. Each activity can change this; switching it on gives seats already pending the deadline from now, and their members are told.
activityPayments.hoursDesc: From when the seat is held. Between 1 and 8760.

spacePayments.title: Paid bookings
spacePayments.intro: How bookings are paid in spaces on the pay-to-confirm flow. These are separate from the activity values: a slot and an event are not paid on the same clock.
spacePayments.booking_payment_cutoff_minutesDesc: A pending booking must be paid at the latest this long before its slot starts. 0 if you take cash at the door and mark it paid before the start.
spacePayments.booking_min_hold_minutesDesc: A booking that would have less time than this to be paid is refused instead of created.
spacePayments.booking_auto_promotion_min_minutes: Shortest time to hand a place out by itself (minutes)
spacePayments.booking_auto_promotion_min_minutesDesc: A place that frees with at least this long to pay goes to the first on the waiting list by itself. With less, the whole list is told and whoever books first takes it.
spacePayments.autoCancelDesc: Besides the margin before the slot, a pending booking is cancelled if it is not paid within the period below. Each space can change it; once on, bookings already pending get the deadline from now (if it is sooner than theirs) and their members are told.
spacePayments.booking_auto_cancel_hoursDesc: From when the place is booked. Between 1 and 8760.
